chunk_map.heading: Cheap building helps your rivals too

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "This is where \"building got cheap, deciding didn't\" stops being an edge on its own." closest to violating: the quoted frame is not named earlier in this one-slide file, but it is the training's own spine claim (arc-earned carve-out), and "This" is the locative point in the story, resolved by the header and the quote above it. Harm (reader cannot resolve a referent) not present.

L10: "What would change this training's mind" is the nearest pointer; it names the training, not another file by position. No "the opening lecture"/"earlier lecture" phrasing in body (grep of lines 1-10 for lecture|module|earlier|opening|session -> 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8/L10: no "the X you did/saw/caught" backward reference to a beat; the only quoted back-claim is the essay quote at L4.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no demo or guess-before-reveal beat on the slide

rules_evaluated.evidence: L8: "When rivals build as cheaply, speed is the entry price, and a product that adds everything it can build gets harder to use." The slide carries a self-standing claim plus a falsifier (L10); not a wait-state.

Header "Cheap building helps your rivals too" vs L4 "The other companies have no choice but to follow" and L8 "When rivals build as cheaply, speed is the entry price": content supports the header. Closest: L10 falsifier paragraph is not about rivals but is the slide's closing turn, not a contradiction.

Per-chunk read: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (L8, L10 have no negation chain); no triple (L10 "choosing the outcome and reading a no as clearly as a yes" is a pair); no self-grading superlative; L4 "twice as effective" / "1000++" sit inside the attested quote with no own retraction; "speed is the entry price" is concrete; no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body lines 1-10 contain no compendium|firing|forcing function|beat|mood|surface-as-noun. Closest L8 "edge" and "entry price" are ordinary business vocabulary. Harm (room cannot parse authorial dialect) absent.
